en: Well, look at you! I'm Sidney of the Elite Four. You came all this way, so I like you already.
text: Ia te uită la tine! Sunt Sidney din Elita celor Patru. Ai venit până aici, așa că mi-ești deja simpatic.

en: But liking you won't stop me. I play dirty, and I play to win. Can you keep up with that?
text: Dar simpatia nu mă oprește. Joc murdar și joc ca să câștig. Poți ține pasul cu asta?

en: No more talking. Let's have a battle we'll both remember!
text: Gata cu vorba. Să dăm o luptă pe care amândoi o vom ține minte!

en: Ha! That's it, I'm beaten. And I don't even mind. That was a battle and a half!
text: Ha! Gata, sunt învins. Și nici nu mă deranjează. A fost o luptă ca la carte!

en: Go on through. The rest of the Elite Four won't go easy on you. Show them what you showed me!
Don't look back now. The next room is waiting for you. Go and win it!
Ha! You again! I've been waiting for this. Same rules as before: I play dirty, and I play to win!
Ha! Beaten again, and I enjoyed every second. You keep getting better, don't you?
